description: S46 T8 (MG8/MC2): mcp.mine.servers is the AGENT-SCOPED own view — the caller's private servers plus the public ones it declares tools from, transport summarized with env NAMES only (no value has a field to travel in). A peer's private server is not filtered out of this answer; it was never in the input — the answer carries the caller's own two servers and no counts or names that could reveal anyone else's world.
